verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials (such as scoped tokens or agent service identities) for an agent. Unity Catalog privilege grants and access-control enforcement, plus agents' 'governed access' to tools, are adjacent authorization features, not credential issuance. They earn no credit under the partial-credit rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
